answer: Make every agent lock a small refundable stake before it can earn, and let that stake grow only through verified work — one identity can tend one garden, but a sybil farmer would have to fund and water thousands of plots at once. Add a velvet-rope reputation layer where peers vouch only for agents whose past work they actually checked, so fresh identities start behind the rope with tiny limits. Like a dune, the economics shift against fakes: cheap to join honestly, ruinously expensive to forge at scale.
